decisions.reason: 草地练习 is Turf practice/training; Luyện tập Turf preserves the activity meaning while using the required player-facing surface label.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community term common.surface.turf requires Turf and forbids Sân cỏ; the current text satisfies it.

decisions.reason: 跑步 means running/jogging; Chạy bộ is a natural concise Vietnamese exercise label.
健身自行车 means an exercise/stationary bicycle; Xe đạp tập is the standard concise Vietnamese label.

长距离游泳 is naturally read here as the exercise name long-distance swimming, matching Bơi đường dài, but the embedded terminology matcher requires the race-distance label Long for 长距离. Applying Long inside this exercise label would be unsafe without canonical context resolving whether this is a false-positive terminology match.
肌肉训练 means muscle training; Tập cơ bắp is natural Vietnamese and preserves the activity meaning.
海边拖轮胎 means dragging a tire at/by the seaside; Kéo lốp bên bờ biển preserves both the exercise and location naturally.
抢答题 denotes a quick-response quiz; Đố nhanh is a concise natural Vietnamese activity label.
海边 means seaside/coast; Bờ biển is a natural concise Vietnamese location label.
温泉 means hot spring; Suối nước nóng is the standard Vietnamese rendering.
抹布擦地 means wiping/mopping the floor with a cloth; Lau sàn bằng giẻ preserves the action and tool naturally.
救球 means saving/retrieving a ball in a ball-sport drill; Cứu bóng is concise and semantically correct.
降落伞跑 is running with a resistance parachute; Chạy kéo dù clearly conveys the exercise.
蛙泳 means breaststroke; Bơi ếch is the standard Vietnamese term.
歌剧式呼吸法 means an opera-style breathing method; the current text Phương pháp thở opera omits the 式 (style/type) relation, while kiểu opera restores it naturally.
赛法斗 refers to Savate, the French combat sport; Savate is the established proper name.
